description: A finished answer to a question, written with [n] citations to live web sources: one deep search reads the top pages and an LLM (gpt-oss-120b) writes the answer from them only, saying what is missing rather than guessing; when the pages lack the answer it searches again with new queries. Use it when you want the answer itself; for quotes only use contextfetch_answer, for raw sources contextfetch_search. ~2 s. Costs $0.001 ($1 per 1,000); depth standard (a short research agent, ~10-15 s, for questions that need several facts) $0.003.

depth.description: fast: one deep search (default). standard: a short research agent that reads pages in full and searches again for what is missing (~10-15 s), for questions that need several facts.

name: contextfetch_agent
title: ContextFetch written answer
